notes.title: DISNEY SPEEDSTORM COMMUNITY PIT STOP - SEASON 14 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
[p]Hey Speedstars,[/p][p]Disney Speedstorm’s Season 14, inspired by Disney and Pixar’s [i]Toy Story[/i], is approaching fast, and the team has been working on changes and improvements to the game based on community feedback.[/p][p][/p][p][b]SEASON 14 CHANGES[/b][/p][p]You can also check out the Season 14 changes outlined in our First Look video.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Tales[/b][/p][p][i]Tales[/i] is a new event format that brings together multiple Limited Events into one evolving experience — with both PvE and PvP challenges, and major rewards up for grabs.[/p][p]Here’s how it works:[/p][list][*][p]New Limited Events unlock progressively throughout each Tale, with each one featuring its own set of quests and objectives.[/p][/*][*][p]Some Limited Events can be grinded endlessly, while others have fixed limit.[/p][/*][*][p]Every point you earn contributes to a global reward track. Progress through Milestones and unlock exclusive prizes as the Tale unfolds.[/p][/*][*][p]Each Tale includes a grand leaderboard that tracks your total score across all connected Limited Events in the chain. Your combined points from participating TLEs will determine your overall rank. The higher you place when the Tale ends, the better your final reward.[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple Tales can run at once — so there’s always a new challenge, and more chances to climb the ranks.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]MULTIPLAYER & ECONOMY EVENTS[/b]  [/p][p][/p][p]We’re also introducing a New Type of Time-Limited Event! [/p][p]This new type of event features new objectives, where players can enjoy competing against the other players, and earn great rewards for achieving the highest scores. Here are the elements that define these events:  [/p][list][*][p] The New Objectives will be actions that are tied to the main gameplay (e.g. participate in multiplayer races.) [/p][/*][*][p] Players will be given unlimited tries to score as many  points as possible. [/p][/*][*][p] The new type of Time Limited Events will have certain milestones that will give rewards.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]RAMP STUNTS INSTANT REACTION[/b][/p][p]We’ve updated how stunts work— giving you more control, more reward, and more chances to leave your rivals in the dust.[/p][p][/p][p]Here’s what’s new:[/p][list][*][p]Performing aerial stunts after launching off a ramp no longer just gives a speed boost when landing.[/p][/*][*][p]Now, each stunt charges your Nitro bar, letting you decide when to unleash your speed.[/p][/*][*][p]The more stunts you pull off in a jump, the more Nitro you build — and Tricksters earn even more per stunt.[/p][/*][*][p]It’s no longer just about landing with style — it’s about using your airtime strategically to power up.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]RACER VOICEOVER[/b][/p][p]This season, Zurg, Forky, Lotso, and both mid-season Racers — Chip 'n' Dale — will receive voice lines in-game.[/p][p][/p][p][b]NEW SUPERCHARGE RACERS[/b][/p][p]Hercules from Disney’s [i]Hercules[/i], Elsa from Disney’s [i]Frozen[/i], EVE from Disney and Pixar’s [i]WALL·E[/i], Stitch from Disney’s [i]Lilo & Stitch[/i], and the one and only Goofy, straight from [i]Mickey & Friends[/i].[/p][p][/p][p][b]FREE CHARACTERS:[/b][/p][p]This season, Buzz Lightyear and Bo Peep from Disney and Pixar’s [i]Toy Story[/i] will be available as the two free characters for all players as a Season Tour reward.[url="#_msocom_1"]\[SO1][/url] [/p][p][/p][p][b]SEASON 14 TOURNAMENT AND VAULT PASS[/b][/p][p]During Season 14, Tournaments and Vault Passes will become available for both Disney Tim Burton’s [i]The Nightmare Before Christmas[/i] and Disney’s [i]Beauty and the Beast[/i].[/p][p]Tournaments will be available for the following Racers: Jack Skellington, Sally, Dr. Finkelstein, Belle, Beast, and Gaston.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]NINTENDO SWITCH 2 ENHANCEMENTS[/b][/h3][p]Starting with this season’s update, players on Nintendo Switch 2 can look forward to a much smoother, sharper racing experience thanks to performance enhancements exclusive to the new hardware:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]The FPS cap has been raised to 60, delivering buttery-smooth racing compared to the previous 30 FPS limit.[/p][/*][*][p]Enjoy 1080p in handheld mode and up to 1440p when docked for a crisper, more detailed look.[/p][/*][*][p]A number of other visual improvements such as better shadows, anti-aliasing, and shader quality to bring even more visual polish to every track.
[/p][/*][/list][p]These upgrades are exclusive to Nintendo Switch 2 players, so make sure your game is updated to get the most out of what the new console has to offer.[/p][p][/p][p][b]GENERAL FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/p][list][*][p]We’ve been hard at work implementing improvements to enhance your day-to-day experience, including:[/p][/*][*][p]Max Racer Level is now displayed in Multiplayer Rankings[/p][/*][*][p]New Multiplayer Level Cap system introduced:[/p][list][*][p]Each league now has a maximum allowed racer level to improve matchmaking fairness.[/p][/*][*][p]Racers above the cap will be adjusted for the race, but crew bonuses and supercharge abilities remain active.[/p][/*][*][p]Level caps are visible in menus and post-race screens.[/p][/*][*][p]If players from multiple leagues are matched together, the lowest league cap applies.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][td][p][b]League[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]Recommended[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]Level Cap[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Bronze[/p][/td][td][p]12[/p][/td][td][p]20[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Silver[/p][/td][td][p]17[/p][/td][td][p]25[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Gold[/p][/td][td][p]24[/p][/td][td][p]30[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Platinum[/p][/td][td][p]30[/p][/td][td][p]35[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Emerald[/p][/td][td][p]34[/p][/td][td][p]40[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Diamond[/p][/td][td][p]40[/p][/td][td][p]45[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Champion[/p][/td][td][p]44[/p][/td][td][p]50[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Grand Champion[/p][/td][td][p]47[/p][/td][td][p]50[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Ultimate Champion[/p][/td][td][p]50[/p][/td][td][p]50[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][list][*][p]Improved mission redirection to help you jump straight into the action[/p][/*][*][p]A free roster of 10 Racers will now be available in Private Track and Local Freeplay, giving all players a chance to test out a variety of characters right away. notes.title: DISNEY SPEEDSTORM BIG HERO 6 - INSPIRED SEASON 13 AVAILABLE NOW
notes.content:
Hey SpeedStars!

The “Microbot Mayhem” season, inspired by Disney’s BIG HERO 6, brings an incredible adventure and new content to the game, including the brand-new “Welcome to San Fransokyo!” racing environment!  

Get up to speed with all the new content arriving in Season 13 additional improvements we tell you all about in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1537830/Disney_Speedstorm/]our most recent Patch Notes. [/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404188/39797d96152c1ef57628fe3b40cd6a32a479a4b4.png[/img]

[h2]3 NEW BIG HERO 6 - INSPIRED RACERS[/h2]
Hiro Hamada, Baymax, and Honey Lemon are revving up their engines to take you on an incredible
race!
Hiro Hamada is a Trickster Class Racer, Baymax is a Brawler Class Racer, and Honey Lemon is a
Trickster Class Racer.

Details of how to unlock each of our 3 racers

•	[b]Hiro Hamada will be unlockable via the premium tier of the Golden Pass Part 1*[/b]
•	[b]Baymax will be unlockable via the premium tier of the Golden Pass Part 2*[/b]
•	[b]Honey Lemon will be unlockable via the Season Tour Chapter 5 & 6[/b]
•	[b]Belle will be unlockable via the Season Pass in Part I[/b]
•	[b]Elsa will be unlockable via the Season Pass in Part II[/b]

*Requires Golden Pass Credit or purchase of €9,99/$9.99 or equivalent in local currency

[h3]Hiro Hamada – SCIENCE IS COOL[/h3]
•	[b]Normal Activation:[/b] Activate one of common power-ups for each blueprint stored (5
blueprints = 5 power-ups)
•	[b]Charged Activation:[/b] Make an invention that gives a short speed boost and permanently
improves top speed of the kart until end of the race.

[h3]Baymax – SATISFIED WITH YOUR CARE[/h3]
•	[b]Normal Activation:[/b] Fires his fists forward (forward unguided projectile) pushing away any
enemies that the fist is in contact with. 
•	[b]Charged Activation:[/b] Baymax expands his wings, gaining immense speed and invulnerability
for a short duration (boost while still allowing full control over the kart).

[h3]Honey Lemon – ON-THE-GO CHEMISTRY[/h3]

come into contact with them suffer different effects based on the ball they come into
contact with
[list]
[*] Wall of foam (slowdown on hit)
[*] Ice puddle (block steering on hit)
[*] Colourful fog cloud (reduce visibility on hit)[/list]
•	[b]Charged Activation:[/b] Honey Lemon becomes intangible and drops the bag of balls behind.
The bag explodes, obfuscating racers in a big radius.

A whole new collection of Crew members will also be added to support you during your races, including:

notes.title: DISNEY SPEEDSTORM COMMUNITY PIT STOP - SEASON 13 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
Hey Speedstars,

Disney Speedstorm’s Season 13, inspired by Disney’s Big Hero 6, is approaching fast, and the team has been working on changes and improvements to the game based on community feedback.

[b]SEASON 13 CHANGES[/b]
You can also check out the Season 13 changes outlined in our [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jaWOIv_HXIY]First Look video[/url].

[b]FESTIVITY CALENDAR[/b]
The Festivity Calendar is a new feature that brings extra daily bonuses. This calendar gives you a chance to grab even more goodies!

Here’s what you need to know:
[list]
[*] You can unlock it at Player Rank 5.
[*] The Calendars can vary in length depending on the occasion. If a Calendar is longer than 7 days, each additional 7th day (usually Sunday) will act as a  Milestone, which provides a bonus.
[*] If you miss a day in a Calendar, you will be allowed to progress through the rest of the Calendar. However, you will lose your Login Streak. Skipped Rewards cannot be claimed in some Calendars, but there may be options to purchase it. 
[*] Claiming all daily rewards, ensures unlocking the special milestone reward on the 7th day.
[*] You cannot have more than one Calendar available at the same time.
[*] Some Calendars might have some conditions: you might need to have a certain Player Rank or Collection Level in order to see them.
[*] The Daily Reward refresh time is the same for every player.[/list]

[b]MULTIPLAYER & ECONOMY EVENTS[/b]

We’re also introducing a New Type of Time-Limited Event! 
This new type of event features new objectives, where players can enjoy competing against the other players, and earn great rewards for achieving the highest scores.
Here are the elements that define these events:
[list]
[*] The New Objectives will be actions that are tied to the main gameplay (e.g. participate in multiplayer races.) 
[*] Players will be given unlimited tries to score as many  points as possible. 
[*] The new type of Time Limited Events will have certain milestones that will give rewards.
[/list]

[b]RACER VOICEOVER[/b]
This season, Racers Hiro Hamada, Baymax, Honey Lemon, and both of the mid-season Racers will receive voice lines in-game. 

[b]RACER BOOST[/b]
Racers Frozone, Mrs. Incredible, Violet, Mr. Incredible, Moana, and Maui will now be available to select.

[b]NEW SUPERCHARGE RACERS[/b]
Racers Donald Duck, Lilo, Mike Wazowski, Meg, and Jessie will be available to select.

[b]SEASON 13 TOURNAMENT AND VAULT PASS[/b]
During Season 13, Tournaments and Vault Passes will become available for Disney’s Pirates of the Caribbean.
Tournaments will be available for all 6 Racers Jack Sparrow, Elizabeth Swann, Will Turner, Hector Barbossa, Davy Jones, and Tia Dalma.

[b]UI IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*] Visual Improvements have been added to the Diamond Pass Interface. 
[*] Some Supercharge Racer UX and UI improvements have been implemented.
[*] Some Instant Max Out UX and UI improvements have been added.
[*] Players will be able to buy Racer and Supercharge Shards directly from the Racer menu. 
[*] An in-race progression bar (tracking the Goals) has been added to the Tutorials.
[*] Visual Improvements have been added to the Shop Bundles.
[/list]

[b]GENERAL FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*] Time Limited Event Global Timer will now reset at a fixed global time each day.
[*] Time Limited Events last for a fixed amount of time but will now be active until completion – this means that the Events will disappear after completion.
[*] Fixed a bug that prompted players to “Claim Offers” without redirecting them to the correct place in the Shop
[*] Various bugs have been fixed in the Onboarding.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the external controllers not to select the Diamond Pass banner when the players clicked on it.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Supercharge VFX to be applied only to the Charged Unique Skills of the Racers.  
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a Supercharge Milestone widget to appear in races where no Milestones were set.  
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused the Supercharge currency not to updated after being purchased via the “Where to get” button.  
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused the Supercharge Timer not to update correctly.
[*] Various game crash occurrences fixed across all platforms.
[/list]

Hey, Speedstars!

We’re back with a new Community Pit Stop. 
Today we’re introducing an exciting new feature: the Diamond Pass. Designed as a premium enhancement to the Golden Pass, the Diamond Pass offers even more value, rewards, and opportunities to supercharge your racing experience. 

Below you’ll find everything you need to know about this new addition to the game.

[h1]A Layer Above the Golden Pass[/h1]
Currently, players can unlock the Golden Pass or the Golden Pass Bundle, which includes 15 tiers of rewards. 

The Diamond Pass builds on this structure by adding a premium layer, granting access to all Golden Pass rewards while also introducing exclusive perks.

[h1]Key Features of the Diamond Pass:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Instant Max Out: Instantly upgrade a racer of your choice (from a predefined selection of 4 racers) to 5 stars and maximum level.
[*] Exclusive Rewards: In addition to the Golden Pass rewards, Diamond Pass holders will receive:
[*] 15 instant tiers of the pass.
[*] One extra daily and weekly mission in seasonal challenges.
[*] A second free daily special.
[*] Additional rewards, including:
[olist]
[*] 300,000 Seasonal Coins.
[*] 3 Season Box Credits.
[*] 10,000 Upgrade Coins.
[*] 1 Epic Racer Capsule
[/olist]
[/list]

[h1]Supercharge Your Racers [/h1]

Diamond Pass players will also enjoy the benefits of the Supercharge system. 
This feature allows select racers to exceed the traditional 5-star and level 50 limits through [b]Supercharging[/b]. 

Players can enhance their racers' Unique Skills and Nitro Boost by collecting [b]Supercharge Shards[/b], adding noticeable upgrades that stand out on the track. 

Select racers can be Supercharged beyond the standard 5-star, level 50 cap by collecting Supercharge Shards. Supercharging adds two levels of upgrades:
1.	Enhanced Unique Skill. 
2.	Enhanced Nitro Boost.

[h1]Golden Pass Content Remains Unchanged[/h1]

We want to reassure all players that the Golden Pass remains the same in both price and rewards. The introduction of the Diamond Pass does not alter the content or progression of the Golden Pass. All players will continue to unlock racers and other rewards through the Golden Pass as they always have. 
The Diamond Pass is simply an optional upgrade for those seeking additional value and exclusive perks.

notes.title: Disney Speedstorm Community Pit Stop – Season 10 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey SpeedStars,

Disney Speedstorm’s Season 10, inspired by Disney Tim Burton’s The Nightmare Before Christmas, is approaching fast, and the team has been working on changes and improvements to the game based on community feedback.

[h2]BOX PITY SYSTEM[/h2]

Starting in Season 10, a pity system will be active for  various boxes in Disney Speedstorm. A pity system essentially guarantees that a player will earn one of the highest value items in a box after opening a set number of boxes.

You can still earn one of those items opening less boxes if you are lucky of course, but this system will guarantee that you will pull one of the highest value items eventually. You will be able to see how many more of a certain box you need to open before the pity system comes into effect before opening any particular box.

The pity system will apply to a select number of boxes in the game initially, with a different number of box openings required for the pity system to come into effect depending on the box.  

[h2]SEASON TOUR CHANGES[/h2]

[h3]GOLDEN PASS PROGRESS[/h3]

Golden Pass XP will now be earned exclusively from completing Daily and Season Missions. Completing Race Goals to earn Medals in the Season Tour Chapters will still unlock additional Race Nodes and Reward Nodes as usual but will no longer earn XP towards Golden Pass progress.

Completing Race Goals will now grant Season Coins instead of XP.

[h3]NEW CHAPTER[/h3]

Previously, the Season Tour chapters contained both a main path and side paths. The side paths typically had higher requirements that players could complete to earn additional rewards.

Starting in Season 10, these side paths will no longer appear in each chapter. They will instead be consolidated into a single additional chapter that will be available from the beginning of the season.

[h3]ARBEE CHALLENGE NODES
[/h3]
A new feature coming to the Season Tour in Season 10 is the introduction of Arbee Challenge Nodes. Once a player has reached Player Rank 25, certain race nodes in the regular Season Tour chapters will become Arbee Challenge Nodes.

Arbee Challenge Nodes will have an extra, more challenging Race Goal with higher level requirements to complete in addition to the usual 3 Race Goals. Players can choose to toggle this feature on or off at any time.

Completing this additional Arbee Challenge Goal will earn players extra progress towards Arbee Challenge Milestones, an additional reward track for players to earn some great in-game items.

[h2]MULTIPLAYER CHANGES[/h2]

[h3]REGULATED MULTIPLAYER
[/h3]
Regulated Multiplayer will now be found within the Limited Events menu. Regulated Multiplayer events will still be regulated to Racer Level 30.

Players will still have unlimited Tries and the rewards will remain unchanged.

[h3]UNIQUE SKILL DROPS[/h3]

Racers can no longer pick up more than 2 Unique Skills in a row.

[h3]COMMON SKILL IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]

•    Brawler, Defender and Trickster Class Racers will no longer pick up Common Skills Boost or Rush when in first position.
•    Speedster Class Racers will no longer be able to pick up more than one of Common Skills Boost or Rush in a row when in first position. 
•    All Racer Classes will no longer pick up Common Skills Fire, Shield, Bomb or Cloak when in last position.
[h3]
NITRO FUEL BOTTLES[/h3]

Currently, only Racers who are within a certain distance of the player in front of them and following their path benefit from the slipstream bonus which fill their Manual Boost Bar.

Starting in Season 10, any Racer that is not actively granting a slipstream bonus because there are no rival Racers in close enough proximity to them for a period of 5 seconds, will start to spawn Nitro Fuel bottles directly behind them on the track every few seconds.

Any other rival player can pick up these Nitro Fuel bottles which will fill their Manual Boost Bar, helping them to catch up to those in front of them. Nitro Fuel bottles cannot be seen or picked up by the Racer who spawned them nor can they be picked up by teammates in Team Mode races.

[h3]RANKED MULTIPLAYER WIN STREAKS
[/h3]
Starting in Season 10, players can now earn a Win Streak bonus for finishing in the podium places in multiple Ranked Multiplayer races in a row.

As you increase your Win streak counter, you will receive additional MPR points each race, up to a max of 5.

Your Win Streak counter will increase via one of the following methods:

•    When you finish in the Top 3 of a Solo Mode Ranked Multiplayer race.
•    When your team wins a Team Mode Ranked Multiplayer race.

Your Win Streak counter will reset if one of the following happens:
•    When you finish 4th place or lower in a Solo Mode Ranked Multiplayer race.
•    When your team loses a Team Mode Ranked Multiplayer race.

If a player loses their Win Streak, they will have the option to use a small number of Tokens to maintain their current Win Streak. The number of Tokens required is dependent on the length of their current Win Streak.

[h2]PARTY MESSAGES[/h2]

Players in a party will now be able to use a small number of party messages while in the matchmaking menu.

[h2]UI IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

•    Visual improvements have been made to the end race animation screen.
•    Additional Shard information is now visible in Shop single offers and bundles.

[h2]SHOP[/h2]

•    Offers for “Maxed” Racers and Crew will no longer appear in the Daily Specials tab.

[h2]SEASON 10 TOURNAMENT AND VAULT PASS[/h2]

During Season 10, Tournaments and a Vault Pass will become available for The Little Mermaid Collection.

Tournaments will be available for Racers Ariel, Ursula, Prince Eric and King Triton from The Little Mermaid Collection.

[h2]RACER BOOST[/h2]

Racers Joy, Sadness, Anger, Disgust, Anxiety, Ennui and Will Turner will now be available to select.

[h2]RACER VOICEOVER[/h2]

This season, Racers Jack Skellington, Sally, Oogie Boogie and the 2 mid-season Racers will receive voice lines in-game*.

*Racer Sally will receive voice lines during the Season 10 mid-season Hotfix for the start of Part 2 of the season.

[h2]GENERAL FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

•    Various game crash occurrences fixed across all platforms.

notes.content:
Hey SpeedStars,

Disney Speedstorm’s Season 9, inspired by Disney’s  Pirates of The Caribbean, is visible just beyond the horizon! The team has prepared a number of improvements based on Community Feedback which are outlined below.

[h2]TREASURE RUSH GAME MODE[/h2]

Season 9 will see the introduction of a new game mode called Treasure Rush. Treasure Rush will task players with gathering special collectibles during races. Your driving skills will be pushed to the limit as you try to juggle picking up as many collectibles as possible while still trying to win the race.

The collectibles you have gathered at the end of the race will be converted into Season Coins and you’ll receive a bonus multiplier if you finish in the podium places. Upgrade Coins will also be earnable via Objective Milestones. There will be a set amount of daily Tries attached to the event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404188/ddf8f90dfd16dfc1e68b9201705153bf99360fdd.png[/img]
 
[h2]UI/UX IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

[h3]PURCHASE ITEMS DIRECTLY FROM THE CUSTOMIZATION MENU[/h3]

notes.title: Disney Speedstorm Community Pit Stop – New Team Mode & Ranked Race Improvements
notes.content:
Hey SpeedStars,

Season 8 of [i]Disney Speedstorm[/i], inspired by Disney and Pixar’s Inside Out is approaching fast and we hope you are as excited as we are! In today’s Community Pit Stop we are going to share details on a highly requested new game mode that will see you teaming up with friends to compete.

We will also break down some very important changes and improvements coming to Ranked Races in Season 8.

[h2]TEAM MODE[/h2]

Your eyes are not playing tricks on you, that’s right, a team vs. team mode is finally coming to [i]Disney Speedstorm[/i]. Team Mode is an exciting and social new way to experience the thrills of [i]Disney Speedstorm[/i] that will see 2 teams of 3 players competing against each other out on the racetrack.

Team Mode is an additional competitive mode in [i]Disney Speedstorm[/i] and as a result, you will now be able to select Solo Mode or Team Mode from the Main Menu when queuing for a Ranked Race.

[h3]REWARDS AND PROGRESSION[/h3]

One of the best features of Team Mode is that you can earn rewards and progression for both your individual Racers and the brand-new Player Rank system, but more on the new Player Rank system later in the article!

Team Mode races grant slightly less progression than Solo Mode Ranked Races, however, the MPR points lost in a Team Mode Ranked Race are also less than in a Solo Mode Ranked Race.

Team Mode is not only a great new way to play competitive [i]Disney Speedstorm[/i], it’s also a great new way to progress in the game for players who find Solo Mode challenging. Teamwork makes the dream work!

[h3]MATCHMAKING AND PARTIES[/h3]

When queuing in Team Mode, players can queue alone or with 1-2 other players. Players who queue alone (solo) will be automatically paired with 2 other players.

There are also no restrictions on the Racers that can make up a player’s team in Team Mode.

[h3]RACE ACTION PHASE[/h3]

During the action phase of Team Mode races, there are a number of important differences to know about when it comes to gameplay mechanics.

[h3]COMMON AND UNIQUE SKILLS[/h3]

The effects of both Common and Unique Skills will only affect the relevant team. For example, the charged activation of Racer Anna’s Unique Skill “Love Thaw” will only grant invulnerability and Manual Boost to Racers on her team and will not affect Racers on the rival team.

Consequently, using the charged activation of the Common Skill “Fire” will only stun Racers on the rival team who are within the Area of Effect (AOE) and will not stun Racers on your own team.

A key strategy is to build the perfect team of Racers, with complementary Unique and Common Skills. Some Racers can shine even more in Team Mode so make sure you try as many combinations as you can!

[h3]DASHING IN TEAM MODE[/h3]

Successfully dashing Racers on the rival team in Team Mode works exactly how it does in Solo Mode. For example, Brawlers stun rival Racers when dashing and Tricksters receive a random Level 1 Common skill from their loadout.

Successfully dashing Racers on your own team in Team Mode is where the fun really begins! Dashing Racers on your own team will not stun or apply a knock back effect, but you can both benefit from the different Racer Class dash bonuses.
[list]
[*]When a Defender Class Racer dashes a teammate, both players will receive a Shield.
[*]When a Speedster Class Racer dashes a teammate, both players will receive a speed boost.
[*]When a Brawler Class Racer dashes a teammate, both players will receive Manual Boost.
[*]When a Trickster Class Racer dashes a Trickster Class teammate, both players will receive a random Level 1 Common Skill from their respective loadouts.
[*]When a Trickster Class Racer dashes a non-Trickster Class teammate, the teammate will receive one of the following Level 1 Common Skills: Boost, Rush, Shield, Shot. The Trickster Class Racer will receive a random Level 1 Common Skill from their loadout.
[/list]
[h3]VICTORY CALCULATION[/h3]

In Team Mode, each individual player is awarded a score based on their finishing position in the race. The team with the highest cumulative score will win the Race. This means that you should compete until the very end of the race as every place counts!

That’s a wrap on the exciting new way to play Team Mode in Disney Speedstorm. We cannot wait to see all of the incredible teamplays and strategies the community comes up with!

We’re not finished however, as we have a lot of information to share on changes and improvements coming to the Ranked Race game mode in general.

[h2]RANKED RACE IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

We have been hard at work making improvements to Ranked Races to make competitive Disney Speedstorm a more rewarding and fulfilling experience for all types of players, while tackling some of the most common points of frustration with the game mode. 

We will break down all of the changes and improvements coming to the Ranked Race game mode in Season 8 below:

[h3]NEW RANKED RACE PROGRESSION SYSTEM: PLAYER RANK[/h3]

The community gave feedback that they would like for there to be more incentives to take part in Ranked Races outside of earning rewards for individual Racers. To address this, we are introducing a brand-new progression and reward system to Ranked Races that adds incentives, outside of the rewards attached to the individual Racers themselves.

[b]Player Rank[/b] is a new progression and reward system that is coming to the Ranked Race game mode in Season 8. This new system is in addition to the existing individual Racer reward and progression paths which will continue as normal in Season 8.

Players can earn [b]Player Rank Points[/b] by progressing through Ranked Race leagues with all of their Racers.

At various Player Rank milestones, players will unlock rewards including Racer Unlocks, Racer Shards Crew Shards, Upgrade Coins, Reward Capsules, Customization items and more!

Racer Steamboat Mickey will now be exclusively unlockable via Player Rank progression.

At the start of Season 8, your Player Rank will be calculated based on the sum of the current MPR Points Score of each of your Racers.

You will be able to claim the rewards associated with the Player Rank milestones you have reached at this point. 

The rewards in the new Player Rank progression system will include nearly all the rewards previously granted by the Collection Level progression system. Some customization items will be reallocated to other areas of the game such as the Multiplayer Boxes. Tokens and some Racer Shard rewards will also be granted through Reward Capsules.

We want to emphasize that rewards are not being removed from the game and , existing players still have the opportunity to earn these Collection Level rewards again via Player Rank.

Players are still able to progress their Collection Level by upgrading and unlocking content in-game, there will just not be any rewards directly associated with it.

This new system places renewed focus on the Ranked Races game mode for all players. In addition to the new Team Mode that allows you to progress in Ranked Races more easily with other players, we are also making several general changes to the game mode to make it a more engaging and rewarding experience while reducing the frustration associated with certain pain points.

[h3]CPU RACERS & MPR GAIN/LOSS[/h3]

Previously, CPU Racers were not factored into the calculation of how many racers were in the lobby, often resulting in players gaining less MPR Points than they deserved at the end of a race.

Starting in Season 8, CPU Racers will be treated as if they were real players when it comes to the calculation of MPR Points gain/loss. This should reduce confusion while also making it easier to progress in the early stages of Ranked Races.

[h3]MPR POINTS GAIN/LOSS[/h3]

The community has flagged that the amount of MPR Points earned based on your finishing position are not high enough while simultaneously, the amount you lose for lower finishing positions can be too punishing. This sentiment is exacerbated at high MPR levels, especially in lobbies with fewer than 8 players.

We identified several goals we wanted to achieve:
[list]
[*]Make it easier and faster to progress in the early stages of Ranked Races.
[*]Make it easier and faster to reach higher leagues.Make losses in higher leagues less punishing, particularly in races with fewer than 8 players.
[*]Make it easier to pick up where you left off at the beginning of a new Ranked Race season.
[/list]
With this in mind, we have redesigned our entire MPR gain/loss tables to make it easier for players at all levels to progress in Ranked Races. This also extends to lobbies with fewer than 8 players.

We have also taken the opportunity to reduce the MPR Points scale. You’ll notice that you are now gaining/losing smaller numbers of MPR Points from Ranked Races. There is no material change here as we have also adjusted the scale of the total MPR Points needed to progress through the different Ranked Race leagues. This will ensure a cleaner UI.

A great way to visualize how this makes progress in Ranked Races quicker is that previously, the average number of races required to reach Diamond League was 81. Under the new system, it will only require an average of 48 races.

[h3]NEW SEASON MPR RESET[/h3]

Starting in Season 8, only Racers in Champion League and above will have their MPR reset at the beginning of new seasons. In addition to this, the reset is restricted to 10 Racers. The 10 Racers with the highest total MPR score in Champion League and above are the only ones affected. These changes will make it much easier for you to pick up where you left off at the start of a brand-new season. The MPR reset does not affect your Player Rank in any way.

[h3]COUNTRY LEADERBOARDS[/h3]

Season 8 will also see the introduction of a “My Country” filter to Ranked Race leaderboards. So, get ready to compete with your compatriots for bragging rights!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404188/791ba97df344199d7cf96689ebabe4520fe2e9be.png[/img]

That’s all the details we have for you on the exciting new Team Mode and Ranked Race reworks coming to [i]Disney Speedstorm[/i] in Season 8! What are you looking forward to trying out first?

notes.content:
Hey SpeedStars, 

Join us as we break down the significant list of Racer balancing changes coming to the game at the start of Season 7.  

To kick things off, we’ll discuss standard balancing changes that will go live in Season 7 and then move onto a more specific issue with Racer stat caps that required several additional stat-based adjustments for Upgrade Level 50 Racers only.

[h2]RACER & SKILL BALANCING[/h2]

[h3]COMMON SKILL: FIRE[/h3]
[list]
    [*]A Racer can only be stunned once by each instance of the backwards activation. 
    [*]The stun duration from the backwards activation has been reduced.
[/list] [h3]COMBAT STAT, BRAWLER RACER CLASS & STUNS[/h3]

The Combat stat in-game directly affects the duration of stuns, whether that be when you stun a rival Racer or when your own Racer is stunned. Our team is implementing changes so Racers getting stunned feels less punishing for players. These adjustments are as follows:  
 [list]
    [*]The duration of a stun for Racers with a low Combat stat will be shorter. 
    [*]The speed reduction effect from being stunned has been lowered. 
    [*]The duration of stuns received from a Brawler Class Racer Dash has been reduced.

[/list][h2]RACER STAT CAPS & CREW CHANGES[/h2]

[h3]RACER STAT CAPS[/h3]

As some players started to “max out” their Racers by reaching 5 Stars and Racer Upgrade Level 50, an issue was identified where stat bonuses granted by Crew members were being “capped”.

After a lengthy investigation by the team, a solution was identified, but it requires re-balancing some stats for Racers at Upgrade Level 50 only. The changes to the affected Racers are listed in full below:

[b]RACER JAFAR[/b]
[list]

[/list][b]RACER HANS[/b]
[list]
[*]Handling stat has been increased.
[/list][b]RACER OLAF[/b]
[list]
[*]Boost stat has been decreased.
[/list][b]RACER SULLEY[/b]
[list]
[*]Top Speed stat has been reduced.
[*]Handling stat has been increased.
[/list][b]RACER RANDALL[/b]
[list]
[*]Boost stat has been increased.
[/list][b]RACER BUZZ LIGHTYEAR[/b]
[list]
[*]Handling stat has been increased.
[/list][b]RACER WOODY[/b]
[list]
[*]Boost stat has been decreased.
[/list][b]RACER MINNIE MOUSE[/b]
[list]
[*]Top Speed stat has been increased.
[/list][b]RACER GOOFY[/b]
[list]
[*]Acceleration stat has been increased.

[list]
[*]Top Speed stat has been increased.

[/list][b]RACER OSWALD[/b]
[list]
[*]Top Speed stat has been reduced.
[/list][b]RACER ORTENSIA[/b]
[list]
[*]Top Speed stat had been reduced.
[/list][b]RACER THE BEAST[/b]
[list]
[*]Boost stat has been increased.
[/list][b]RACER MULAN[/b]
[list]
[*]Top Speed stat has been increased.
[/list][h3]CREW CHANGES[/h3]

The previously mentioned Stat Cap changes gave us an opportunity to review how Crew stat bonuses are applied. Previously, Crew members granted a purely numerical stat bonus, for example, +500 to Top Speed. Going forward, Crew members will now grant percentage-based stat bonuses with the max percentage for each individual stat being +5%. Taking the Top Speed stat as an example, the 5% bonus is tied to the maximum possible Top Speed stat for a Racer.

These changes also allow us to increase the number of different Racer stats a Crew member can grant bonuses to. This means that Common Crew members will now grant bonuses to 2 different stats, while Rare Crew members will now grant bonuses to 3 different stats.

We are also making a change to normalize the behavior of Epic Crew members. Previously, Epic Crew members granted a higher stat bonus to Epic Racers than to Common or Rare Racers. From now on, Epic Crew will grant the same stat bonuses, regardless of the rarity of the Racers they are equipped to.

We are also making some adjustments to the skill bonus granted by the following Crew members:
[list]

[*]Auto will now grant a skill bonus to Rush instead of Shot. (WALL•E Collection)
[*]Mrs. Hasagawa will now grant a skill bonus to Shot instead of Hack. (Lilo & Stitch Collection)
[*]Elephant On A Bicycle will now grant a skill bonus to Hack instead of bomb (Oswald the Lucky Rabbit Collection)
[/list]That’s it for all the balancing changes to Season 7. See you all out on the racetrack!

Hey SpeedStars!

[previewyoutube=aJadg_8qKcY;full][/previewyoutube]

Racers Ralph, Vanellope von Schweetz, Sergeant Calhoun, Fix-it Felix, and King Candy are ready to take on a sweet new racing challenge.
Ralph is a Brawler Class Racer, Vanellope a Speedster, Sergeant Calhoun a Brawler, Fix-it Felix is a Defender, and King Candy is a Trickster Class Racer. 

How to unlock each of these new seasonal Racers: 
[list]
[*] Ralph will be unlockable via the Season Tour in both Parts

[*] Sergeant Calhoun will be unlockable via the premium tier of the Golden Pass Part 2*

[h2]UNIQUE SKILLS FOR WRECK-IT RALPH INSPIRED RACERS [/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Normal Activation[/b]: Ralph pounds on the ground for a very short time. Each pound gives him a small push forward and stuns nearby opponents in a small radius.
[*] [b]Charged Activation[/b]: Ralph pounds on the ground strongly three times. Each pound gives him a strong push forward and stuns opponents in a medium radius.

notes.title: Disney Speedstorm Community Pit Stop – Tournaments and Golden Pass Changes
notes.content:
Hey SpeedStars, 

We’re back with another Community Pit Stop! Today we’re introducing an exciting new feature to Disney Speedstorm, based on the community’s valuable feedback: Tournaments. Read on to find out all about it, as well as changes coming to the Season Tour and Golden Pass starting in Season 7. 

Tournaments are a way for players to access content from previous Seasons through new multi-stage Racer Tournaments and earn seasonal-themed trophies and rewards from previous Golden Passes via the new Vault Passes. 

The game’s new main menu layout will now include a “World Map” button, which will take players to the current Season as well as the Tournaments. 

During Season 7, Tournaments inspired by Disney and Pixar’s Monsters, Inc., Toy Story, and Disney’s Lilo & Stitch will gradually become available, and all World Tournaments will not have time limitations to complete. More Tournaments will be added at a later date. 

So how do the tournaments work? Let’s take a closer look! 

[h2]RACER TOURNAMENTS[/h2]

In a Tournament, each Racer from that Season has a set of Racer Tournaments. Each Racer Tournament will consist of four races for each of three difficulty-based Cups. Players can play any tournament for the Racers they have unlocked. For example, if players have Racer Mike Wazowski unlocked, they can start racing in his specific Racer Tournaments inside the Monsters, Inc. Tournaments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404188/2ff453385cd965d73c6414cf20872cbf299b8e6d.png[/img]

In each Racer Tournament, players will earn Vault Points and Trophies based on their placement. Players must place at least in third to start earning points and Trophies. The three Tournaments break down as follows: 
[list]
    [*]Novice Cup, with the Recommended Racer Level 10. 
    [*]Pro Cup, with the Recommended Racer Level 20.
    [*]Super Cup, with the Recommended Racer Level 30.
[/list] 
Players will earn a Bronze Trophy if they reach 3rd place as their best position in the final tournament leaderboard, a Silver Trophy if they reach 2nd place and a Gold Trophy if they reach 1st place.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404188/f0dcd05ec017fb71d79d748ac471c19907c6758c.png[/img]

All Tournaments will have a common Daily Tries system through Tournament Tickets. Players who have not purchased a Vault Pass will have 4 tickets available to them across the Tournaments. If a player has purchased a Vault Pass, they will have unlimited tickets in the Tournaments tied to that World. 

[h3]THE VAULT PASS[/h3]

Each previous Season’s Tournaments will be attached to a “Vault Pass”, which will bring back rewards from that Season’s Golden Pass.  

Players will advance in the Vault Pass by participating in the Tournaments tied to that Season and earning Vault Points. Similar to the Golden Pass, the Vault Pass will have both free and premium rewards, as players will be able to purchase the Vault Pass. Each Season’s Vault Pass will have similar rewards to the Season’s original Golden Pass, including Racer and Crew unlocks and vanity items, as well as new exclusive kart colors. 

The premium track of each Vault Pass will be available as a direct purchase for $7.99/€7.99 or equivalent in local currency. 

A Vault Pass Bundle will also be available as a direct purchase for $15.99/€15.99 or equivalent in local currency, allowing you to skip the first 15 tiers immediately. 

[h2]NEW GOLDEN PASS & SEASON TOUR STRUCTURE [/h2]

Starting in Season 7, significant structural changes will be coming to both Golden Passes and the Season Tour. A high-level summary of the changes can be found below, and these are further explained in more detail. We encourage you to read everything so you can better plan out your approach to Season 7.  

Our goals with the changes are:  
[list]
    [*]Make our Golden Passes more engaging and faster to complete for players.
    [*]Allow players to focus more on which Racers they wish to unlock via Golden Passes.
    [*]Give more rewards to players that can be used on any Racer in the game.
[/list] 
The high-level summary of the changes is below:  
[list]
    [*]Seasons will now be split into 2 parts of approximately 1 month.  
    [*]Each part will contain 4-5 Season Tour Chapters.  
    [*]Each part will have a free Golden Pass track which means there’s now 100 tiers of rewards to earn for free.
[*]Tiers will now require 1000 XP to complete, a 50% drop, making rewards quicker to earn. 
[*]Each part will have a premium Golden Pass for $9.99/€9.99 or equivalent in local currency.  
[*]Each part will have a premium Golden Pass Bundle for $19.99/€19.99 or equivalent in local currency that includes 15 tier skips.  
[*]Golden Passes will no longer be purchasable with Tokens, only as a direct purchase.  
[*]Golden Pass Credits can still be used to unlock the premium Golden Pass.   
[/list] 

[h3]SEASON TOUR LENGTH AND PARTS [/h3]

We have noticed that since the game was released in Early Access in April 2023, 83% of players do not reach Tier 50 of our Golden Pass. This number is even higher for players who start later in the season.   

We aim to make both the Season Tour and by extension, the Golden Pass faster to complete for players by dividing it into 2 separate parts of approximately 1 month each. Having a new part to focus on each month will give players something fresh and new to focus on at the midpoint of the Season.  

The Season Tour will still have a total of 9-10 Chapters as is currently the case. The Chapters will be split between each part. You do not need to purchase a Golden Pass to access the Season Tour Chapters during Part 1 or Part 2, but players will not be able to access the Part 1 Season Tour Chapters after the conclusion of Part 1.  

There will continue to be a Racer available for free via the Season Tour. In Season 7, there will be 20 Shards available from Part 1 Chapters, and 20 more available from Part 2 Chapters. This means that at a minimum all players are guaranteed to unlock this Racer and can take them to 2 Stars if you earn all the Shards on offer across both parts’ Chapters.

[h3]GOLDEN PASSES [/h3]

Starting in Season 7, each part will have its own dedicated Golden Pass with free and premium tracks. The premium Golden Pass will no longer be purchasable with Tokens and will only be available as a direct purchase for $9.99/€9.99 or equivalent in local currency.  

Golden Pass Bundles will also be available for each part as a direct purchase for $19.99/€19.99 or equivalent in local currency, allowing you to skip the first 15 tiers immediately.  

It’s also important to note that Season Pass Credits can still be used to unlock premium Golden Passes.  

Each part’s Golden Pass will have the same number of rewards as the full season-long Golden Passes available in previous seasons, so players can earn double the rewards they could before. 

Players will now have 100 tiers to earn in the free track of the Golden pass, compared to 50 tiers previously. The amount of XP required to complete each tier, up until tier 46, is also being reduced from 2000 XP to 1000 XP, so players should be able to complete the pass in half the time. The amount of XP required to complete tiers 46-49 will be 1250 XP, while the amount of XP required for the repeatable tier of the Golden Pass will increase incrementally.

Also, with the removal of Upgrade Parts outlined in our previous [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1537830/partnerevents/edit/4129310730562181952]Community Pit Stop[/url], the new Upgrade Coin currency will take their place as rewards in the Golden Pass, allowing players to upgrade their favorite Racers more easily.  

The free track of each part’s Golden Pass will contain 30 Shards for another Racer, meaning that at a minimum all players are guaranteed to unlock this Racer and can take them to 2 Stars if you earn all the unlockable Shards across the 2 passes.  

Each part’s premium Golden Pass will feature a different Racer. Players who purchase each part’s premium Golden Pass will be able to earn 70 Shards for the featured Racer, enough to unlock them and bring them to 3 Stars. If you join after the conclusion of Part 1’s Golden Pass, the Racer featured in that pass will be available in the Shop. 

That’s a wrap on a brand-new way to access previous season’s content and the new Season Tour/Golden Pass structure! Thanks for taking the time to read the whole article, we’ll see you out on the racetrack!  

Don't forget to follow us on our [url=https://linktr.ee/disneyspeedstorm]social media channels[/url] for all the latest news!

notes.title: Disney Speedstorm Community Pit Stop – Upgrade System Rework
notes.content:
Hey SpeedStars,

Today we are sharing details on a rework of how players will upgrade and Star Up their Racers in Disney Speedstorm beginning in Season 7. The important goals of this rework are:

[olist]
[*]Simplify the Upgrade Parts system by converting all Upgrade Parts into a single currency called “[b]Upgrade Coins[/b]” which [u]can be used on all Racers[/u].  
[*]Create a closer link between Racer Upgrade Levels and Racer Star Levels.  
[*]Create short to medium term goals between Racer Star Levels.  
[/olist]
The new system should be a simpler, more engaging experience for players, giving more value and utility to each and every Racer Shard you earn. This will apply to all existing Racers and those joining the race in Season 7 and beyond. 

Your current inventory of Upgrade Parts will automatically convert to the equivalent amount in Upgrade Coins at the start of Season 7. Given Upgrade Coins can be used to upgrade any Racer, the utility of your inventory will increase.

[h2]CURRENT PROGRESSION SYSTEM[/h2] 

[h3]RACER SHARDS & UPGRADE PARTS SYNERGY [/h3]

In the current progression system, players are required to earn 10 Racer Shards to unlock a Racer. Once unlocked, a Racer’s stats can be improved by using Upgrade Parts until they reach the next Star Up limit of Upgrade Level 15. Players are then required to earn an additional 20 Racer Shards to unlock Star Level 2 before they can continue to improve their Racer’s stats further with Upgrade Parts.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404188/f5cf7493adb29eef5c77e07d151495e6c544f58d.png[/img]
(*Total Shards accumulated to reach this point)

This system continues until players reach 5 Stars and Racer Upgrade Level 50 to “max out” a Racer. Players are currently not required to increase their Racer’s Upgrade Level alongside their Star Ups, however. For example, it’s possible to have a Racer at 5 Stars and Racer Upgrade Level 1.  

This creates a disconnect between the 2 key parts of the upgrade system and only gives a sense of reward and value to the final Racer Shard required to reach the next Star Up bracket.  

Our goal is to create more synergy between the 2 key aspects of the upgrade system, while also making every Racer Shard earned feel more valuable and impactful.

[h2]NEW PROGRESSION SYSTEM[/h2]

[h3]STAR LEVELS [/h3]

The new progression system will see both Upgrade Parts and Racer Shards working in unison to improve your Racer’s stats. 10 Racer Shards are still required to unlock a Racer in the new progression system, but now, a small number of Racer Shards will be required to increase your Racer Upgrade Level, in addition to Upgrade Coins.  

For example, under the current progression system, leveling up to Racer Upgrade Level 10 required Energy Cans, Energy Can Duos and Racing Helmets. Under the new system, players will need to spend 9 of the 10 Racer Shards they earned to unlock the Racer in addition to 2,090 Upgrade Coins to reach Racer Upgrade Level 10.  

2 Racer Shards per Racer Upgrade Level are required from Racer Upgrade Level 11, and this increases incrementally to a maximum of 10 Racer Shards per Racer Upgrade Level at Racer Upgrade Levels 48-50.  

Finally, under the current progression system Star Ups were achieved purely by earning a certain number of Racer Shards. Each Star Up also has Racer Upgrade Level caps set at levels 15, 25, 35, 45 and 50.  

Under the new system with Racer Star Ups and Racer Upgrade Levels now working in tandem, Racer Star Ups will now happen at Racer Upgrade Levels 20, 30, 40 and 50.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404188/33a422f55a04537af97164d4273a47eeee6cb05e.png[/img]

[h3]UPGRADE COINS [/h3]

We are further simplifying the Upgrade Parts system in the game to make it easier to understand, while giving players more agency on which Racers to upgrade and when.  
 
We are converting 11 different universal Upgrade Parts and 66 Collection-based Upgrade Parts into a single currency called Upgrade Coins that can be used on all Racers regardless of Racer Class or Collection.  

Your current inventory will convert to the equivalent amount of Upgrade Coins at the start of Season 7. The main difference is that players will be able to upgrade all Racers with a single currency.  

We have outlined the number of Upgrade Coins needed per Racer Upgrade Level in the table below.  

If a player runs out of Upgrade Coins but has the required number of Racer Shards to reach the next level, it will be possible to use Tokens instead of Upgrade Coins to reach the next Racer Upgrade Level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404188/feaaea743c8594c5f8e4ab17a34ac826fac6a71b.png[/img]

Well, there you have it! Our new streamlined progression system will go live at the start of Season 7.

notes.title: Disney Speedstorm Community Pit Stop – Season 6 Improvements
notes.content:
Hey SpeedStars, 

[i]Disney Speedstorm[/i] Season 6, “Under the Sea”, inspired by the animated classic [i]Disney’s The Little Mermaid[/i] is approaching fast! The team has been hard at work making improvements to the game experience based on community feedback, and we’re here to share them with you! 

[h2]TELEPORT SKILL[/h2]

[list]
    [*]The duration of the teleportation granted by the Teleport Skill has been reduced and is now consistent. It is no longer calculated based on a player’s distance from the Racer in first place.  
    [*]The trail left by a Racer using Teleport is now longer and persists for a longer period of time to make it clearer to other players that someone has teleported.
[/list] 

[h2]RACER BALANCING[/h2]

[h3]TRICKSTERS[/h3]

Dashing a rival with a Trickster Class Racer will no longer apply the Hack Skill effect to the rival Racer, it will now grant the Trickster a random level 1 Common Skill from their own skill loadout. 

[h3]RACER ELIZABETH SWANN [/h3]

[list]
    [*]The length of the trail effect from Elizabeth’s charged Unique Skill has been reduced by 50%.  
    [*]The duration of Elizabeth’s charged Unique Skill has been increased by 1 second across all Star levels.[/list] 

[h3]RACER STEAMBOAT MICKEY [/h3]

[list]
    [*]The length of the trail effect from Steamboat Mickey’s charged Unique Skill has been reduced by 35%.  
    [*]Manual Boost is now granted to Steamboat Mickey each time a rival Racer enters the trail effect of his charged Unique Skill.  
    [*]Steamboat Mickey’s Top Speed stats have been increased.  
[/list] 

[h3]RACER STEAMBOAT PETE [/h3]

[list]
    [*]Steamboat Pete’s Acceleration and Handling stats have been increased.  
[/list] 

[h3]RACER OLAF [/h3]

[list]
    [*]The length of the trail effect from Olaf’s charged Unique Skill has been reduced by 35%. 
    [*]The duration of the stun effect from Olaf’s charged Unique Skill has been reduced by 50%.
    [*]Manual Boost is now granted to Olaf each time a rival Racer enters the trail effect of his charged Unique Skill. 
[*]Olaf’s Top Speed stats have been increased. 
[/list] 

[h3]RACER LILO [/h3]

[list]
    [*]The trail effect of the charged activation of Lilo’s Unique Skill no longer stuns rival Racers.  
    [*]Lilo’s Top Speed stats have been increased. 
[/list] 

[h3]RACER ALADDIN [/h3]

[list]
    [*]The speed at which Aladdin travels while the uncharged activation of his Unique Skill is active has been reduced by 15 KPH/9 MPH across all Star/Upgrade levels.  
[/list] 

[h3]RACER JASMINE [/h3]

[list]
    [*]The duration of the normal activation of Jasmine’s Unique Skill has been reduced by 20%.  
    [*]Jasmine is now invulnerable while the normal activation of her Unique Skill is active.  
    [*]The duration of the charged activation of Jasmine’s Unique Skill has been reduced by 20%.  
[*]The amount Rajah moves while the charged activation of Jasmine’s Unique Skill is active has been reduced by 10%.  
[*]Jasmine now generates Manual Boost while the charged activation of her Unique Skill is active. 
[*]Jasmine’s Top Speed stats have been increased. 
[/list]
    
[h3]RACER KRISTOFF [/h3]


[list]
    [*]The duration of the charged activation of Kristoff’s Unique Skill has been reduced by 1 second across all Star levels.   
    [*]The amount Sven moves while the normal activation of Kristoff’s Unique Skill is active has been reduced by 10%.  
    [*]Kristoff now generates Manual Boost for every rival Racer Sven stuns while the charged activation of his Unique Skill is active. 
[*]Kristoff’s Top Speed stats have been increased. 
[/list] 

[h3]RACER ANNA [/h3]

[list]
    [*]The duration of both the normal and charged activations of Anna’s Unique Skill has been reduced by 20% across all Star/Upgrade levels. 
    [*]The amount of Manual Boost generated by both the normal and charged activation of Anna’s Unique Skill has been reduced by 20% across all Star levels.  
[/list] 

[h3]RACER ELSA [/h3]

[list]
    [*] Elsa’s Top Speed stats have been increased. 
[/list] 

[h3]RACER HANS [/h3]

[list]
    [*]Hans will now be invulnerable in addition to invisible while the normal activation of his Unique Skill is active.
[*] Hans’ Top Speed stats have been increased. 
[/list] 

[h3]RACER BELLE [/h3]

[list]
    [*]The duration of the speed boost granted by touching the birds while Belle’s charged Unique skill is active has been reduced by 20%.  
[/list] 

[h3]RACER BEAST[/h3] 

[list]
    [*]The Beast’s Acceleration and Handling stats have been increased.
[/list] 

[h3]RACER MIKE WAZOWSKI [/h3]

[list]
    [*]The teleportation distance granted by doors from both the normal and charged activations of Mike Wazowski’s Unique Skill has been reduced by 10%.  
[/list] 

[h3]RACER FIGMENT [/h3]

[list]
    [*]Both the normal and charged Unique Skill activations now grant Figment 1 speed boost star regardless of whether a rival Racer is inside the skill’s Area of Effect (AOE).  
[/list] 

[h3]RACER HERCULES [/h3]

[list]
    [*]The duration of the speed boost granted by both the normal and charged activations of Hercules’ Unique Skill has been increased by 0.5 seconds.  
    [*]The durations of both the normal and charged activations of Hercules’ Unique Skill have been increased by 1 second.  
[/list] 

[h3]RACER MINNIE MOUSE [/h3]

[list]
    [*]Minnie Mouse’s Top Speed stats have been reduced. 
[/list] 

[h3]RACER SHANG [/h3]

[list]
    [*]Shang’s Top Speed stats have been increased. 
[/list] 

[h3]RACER MOWGLI [/h3]

[list]
    [*]The wolves from Mowgli’s Unique Skill will no longer disappear if they collide with a rival Racer’s projectiles. 
[/list] 

[h2]GAMEPLAY [/h2]

[h3]STUNS & WALLS [/h3]

We have made adjustments that should reduce the number of instances where Racers end up trapped against walls after being stunned.  

[h3]AIRLIFT MOMENTUM  [/h3]

We have made adjustments that should reduce the instances where Racers are unable to traverse areas such as the nets in The Silver Screen race environment due to a lack of momentum.  

[h2]SEASON TOUR [/h2]

[h3]SEASON TOUR CHAPTER PREVIEW  [/h3]

Players will now be able to preview locked Season Tour chapters. Upcoming race conditions and rewards will be visible which will allow players to plan their progression better throughout the whole season.  

[h2]LIMITED EVENTS [/h2]

[h3]RACER BOOST  [/h3]

Aladdin, the Genie, Jafar, Hades, Gaston, Kristoff and Hans are now available to select.  

[h2]SHOP [/h2]

[h3]SEASON BOX [/h3]

The Season Box is being split into seasonal Racer-specific boxes. Each of the new boxes will include Racer Shards for that particular Racer, as well as Crew Shards. Players will be able to use Season Box Credits on any of the available Season Boxes 

While the free Golden Pass track and seasonal Time Limited Event Racers will have their boxes available for all players from the start of the Season, the premium Golden Pass track and Season Tour Racers’ boxes will only become available in the Shop once that Racer is unlocked. 

[h3]MULTIPLAYER COIN BOX [/h3]

The Multiplayer Coin Box is being split into 2 separate boxes.  

[list]
    [*]1 Box containing Plates, Avatars, Kart Colors, and Mottos, for 200 Multiplayer Coins. 
    [*]1 Box containing Race Suits, Kart Liveries, Kart Wings, Wheels and Victory Animations, for 600 Multiplayer Coins.  
[/list] 

[h2]GENERAL FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS [/h2]

[list]
    [*]Improvements have been made for de-sync issues with trail-based Common & Unique Skills.  
    [*]New loading screens with Unique Skill descriptions have been added.  
    [*]Additional race Objectives have been added to Season Tour, Limited Events, and Missions. 
[*]Racer Star Levels are now visible in the Edit Racer menu.  
[*]New players now have the option to unlock one additional Racer after completing the first Starter Circuit race. New players can choose one Racer from Belle, Donald Duck, Mike Wazowski, Mulan, Jack Sparrow & Jessie. 
[*]Fixed an audio bug that caused the sound of Shang’s charged Unique Skill to keep playing beyond the duration of the skill.
[/list]

notes.title: Disney Speedstorm Golden Pass Deep Dive
notes.content:
[h2]WHAT IS THE GOLDEN PASS? [/h2]

Hey SpeedStars,

The Golden Pass is Disney Speedstorm’s twist on a Battle Pass which gives players the opportunity to unlock both seasonal and universal rewards. There are a few ways to progress through the 50 tiers of rewards, from completing Race Goals in the Season Tour, to completing Daily or Season Missions. You can also purchase tiers for 500 Tokens each.

We are currently running a [url=https://gmlft.co/DS-GP-SWEEPSTAKES]Sweepstakes[/url] where you can win some incredible in-game rewards, including free Golden Pass Credits! Be sure to read all the way through so you don’t miss any key information for the quiz portion of the Sweepstakes!  

[h2]PREMIUM GOLDEN PASS[/h2]
The premium Golden Pass is a totally optional purchase which gives you access to a plethora of additional rewards, including an additional seasonal Racer and other exclusive cosmetic rewards. The premium Golden Pass is available for only 990 Tokens or 1 Golden Pass Credit, if you’re a Founder who still has one. For those who like to get off to a quick start, you can purchase the Golden Pass Bundle for 1500 Tokens which automatically unlocks the first 15 tiers! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404188/7a748b8c9f7a75554a4e3f168d4a23a858350347.gif[/img]

[h2]FREE GOLDEN PASS[/h2]
All 50 tiers of the Golden Pass are earnable without the need to spend Tokens. Players can simply progress through the tiers by playing the game and still unlock amazing rewards such as a seasonal Racer, Upgrade Parts, Season Coins and cosmetic items. You can choose to purchase the premium Golden Pass at any point during a season, but don’t worry, you will still earn all of the premium rewards from tiers you have previously unlocked. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404188/aa316c38d91e70d78ed4a9a736dab02169972fae.jpg[/img]

[h2]REPEATABLE FINAL TIER[/h2]
If you happen to complete all 50 tiers of the Golden Pass before the end of the current season, don’t think about going into cruise control just yet! The final tier of the Disney Speedstorm Golden Pass is repeatable, so you can continue to collect XP and earn additional Season Box Credits to unlock additional rewards from the current season. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404188/9a4f268bce4f72a1e4e57cffd13c4b59b9bf3713.jpg[/img]

[h2]DAILY MISSIONS[/h2]
Every day in Disney Speedstorm comes with 3 new Daily Missions to complete, each worth 250 XP. That’s an extra 5,250 XP or over 2 Golden Pass levels to earn each week by completing some very simple tasks! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404188/f716f2c5becd02ec1c77edf60529f2ac4f09ca01.jpg[/img]

[h2]SEASON MISSIONS[/h2]
Every Disney Speedstorm season comes with 8 sets of Season Missions, with each Mission being worth either 650 XP or 1400 XP. A new set of Missions is added every week and are available for the entirety of the current season, so you don’t need to worry about them being reset like the Daily Missions. 
These are a fantastic way to level up the Golden Pass quickly as you have a total of 76,000 XP to earn throughout the whole season! That’s a whole 38 Golden Pass levels via Season Missions alone! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404188/2fb58633502af0b2a17d5c399e868702ce31c661.jpg[/img]

That’s a wrap on our deep dive on the Disney Speestorm Golden Pass! Make sure to use what you’ve learned here to enter our [url=https://gmlft.co/DS-GP-SWEEPSTAKES]Golden Pass Sweepstakes[/url] before it’s too late! 

No purchase necessary. 13+, 12/04/23-12/11/23. Void where prohibited.

notes.title: Disney Speedstorm Community Pit Stop – Season 5 Improvements
notes.content:
Hey SpeedStars,

[i]Disney Speedstorm[/i] Season 5, “Let It Go”, is approaching fast! The team has been hard at work making improvements to the game experience based on community feedback, and we’re here to share them with you!

[h2]LIMITED EVENTS[/h2]

[h3]UPGRADE YOUR RACER OF CHOICE[/h3]

A new type of Time Limited Event will be introduced in Season 5 that will give players more flexibility on the Racers they wish to upgrade. In this new Time Limited Event, players will be able to select a specific Racer from a selection to earn rewards for, giving you more agency on how you progress in the game. 

Once a player has completed all Objectives for a particular Racer, they will need to wait for the refresh timer to reset to be able to select a different Racer to progress. Players will also have the option to automatically reset the refresh timer by using Tokens. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404188/5498fc63b31f0ca28ddcea5f59ba4c9f18542dec.png[/img]

[h3] “IT ALL STARTED WITH A MOUSE” TIME LIMITED EVENT[/h3]

The “It All Started With A Mouse” Limited Event previously enabled players to earn 1 Mickey Mouse Racer Shard each day until they reach Star Level 3 with Mickey. Players will now be able to earn 1 Shard each day via this Time Limited Event, all the way to Star Level 5. 

[h2]RANKED MULTIPLAYER[/h2]

[h3]RANKED REWARDS[/h3]

Starting in Season 5, we will be increasing the amount of Upgrade Parts players can earn by playing Ranked Multiplayer for all Racers. This change is aimed at making it easier for players to reach Star Level 3 with each Racer.

Rewards for progressing through the different MPR Leagues can only be earned once, which means that some of our veteran players will not be able to benefit from the aforementioned increase in rewards. 

[h3]LOBBY SIZE[/h3]

The game will now prioritize having at least 3 players in the lobby before a Race is launched. This should reduce the number of 1 vs 1 races at the highest MPR levels. 

[h3]RACER BALANCING[/h3]

[b]STITCH[/b]

•	The Normal and Charged Activations no longer grant Stitch invulnerability.

[b]JESSIE[/b]

•	Both Normal and Charged Activations spawn fewer toys.

[b]STEAMBOAT PETE[/b]

•	Both Normal and Charged Activations spawn fewer ink blots.

[h3]OBSTACLE COMMON/UNIQUE SKILLS [/h3]

We are making a change to Common and Unique Skills that create obstacles to stun rivals. If you are stunned by an obstacle created by a rival’s Common or Unique Skill, you will be stunned for a shorter duration and will lose less speed. 

The Skills currently in the game affected by this change are outlined below. This change will also be reflected in all obstacle-based Skills that stun rivals introduced in the future.

[b]COMMON SKILLS[/b]

Bomb – Backwards Activation

[b]UNIQUE SKILLS[/b]

Jessie – Normal & Charged Activation
Steamboat Pete – Normal & Charged Activation 
Captain Gantu – Normal & Charged Activation
Baloo – Normal Activation
Belle – Normal Activation
Hercules – Charged Activation

[h2]SEASON TOUR[/h2]

[h3]DAILY & SEASON MISSIONS. [/h3]

•	Daily Missions now grant 250 XP towards your Golden Pass progress.
•	Season Missions now grants either 650 or 1400 XP towards your Golden Pass progress.

[h3]MYSTERY RACES[/h3]

Mystery Race Boxes in the Season Tour now require less races to earn all the rewards. The amount of rewards has not been reduced.

[h2]GENERAL FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

•	Daily and Season Missions can now be completed in all game modes except Local Freeplay. 
•	The skip button now works as intended during the race intro animation.

notes.title: Disney Speedstorm Hotfix – November 2
notes.content:
Hey SpeedStars,

We hope you’ve been enjoying [i]Disney Speedstorm[/i]’s fourth Season, “The Cave of Wonders”. It’s been amazing to see so many new players hit the track after our full launch. The team has been hard at work making improvements based on your invaluable feedback and we’ve got a mid-season hotfix primed and ready for [b]November 2[/b]! 

[h2]RANKED MULTIPLAYER PARTY LEVEL REQUIREMENTS [/h2]

In Ranked Multiplayer, the party system was being exploited by a small portion of the player base. To address this issue and to help improve matchmaking in general we have now introduced Racer Upgrade limits to Multiplayer parties. 

This means a party cannot be comprised of Racers with an Upgrade Level difference of more than 10 levels. For example, if a Racer is Upgrade Level 1, the maximum Upgrade Level you can queue in a party with is Upgrade Level 11 or a level 40 Racer cannot queue with a level 29 Racer and so on. 

We will monitor how this new system works and adjust it based on community feedback, if needed. 

[h2]RANKED MULTIPLAYER MATCHMAKING 
[/h2]

Racers with a very high Upgrade Level but very low MPR League will no longer be matched with Racers with both a low Upgrade Level and MPR League. This change should improve the initial Ranked Multiplayer experience for new players, while ensuring more challenging races for experienced players. 

[h2]HOP EXPLOIT [/h2]

Players were able to exploit both Common and Unique Skills that grant a speed boost by repeatedly hopping after activating the skill to maintain top speed for a longer duration than intended. It is no longer possible to maintain top speed by hopping repeatedly when using one of these skills. 

[h2]DASH FIXES[/h2]

notes.title: Disney Speedstorm Dev Diary – Upgrade Parts Improvements
notes.content:
Hey SpeedStars! 

In our most recent Season 4 Improvement [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1537830/view/3730726309732181329]Community Pit Stop[/url] we outlined some improvements to the Upgrade Parts system in the game. Those changes are now live in-game and we wanted to dig a little deeper into why we made those changes here. 

We received feedback from the community that the previous Upgrade Parts system was difficult to keep track of due to the amount of different Upgrade Parts needed to level up Racers. We took this feedback on board with the aim of simplifying and streamlining the whole system. 

We would like to thank our amazing community for their feedback that helped us improve this system. The input of our player’s is integral to taking Disney Speedstorm from strength to strength. 

The main improvements to the system are outlined in the bullet points below and we go into more detail on important aspects in the rest of the Dev Diary. 

[*]The total number of different Upgrade Parts used to level up Racers was reduced from 15 to 10. 
[*]The rarity of Upgrade Parts now better reflect their importance. 
[*]The new system gives players more freedom when upgrading Racers from Level 1-15 as Collection based Upgrade parts are not required at these levels.
[*]Upgrade Parts now have more detailed tags and descriptions explaining their usefulness, with several Upgrade Parts also receiving visual improvements. 

[h2]LEVELING UP[/h2]

It was imperative for us to ensure that players were not negatively affected by the new system. We wanted the experience of upgrading Racers to feel familiar for experienced players, but also simpler for new players and veterans alike. 

You may notice that less Upgrade Parts are awarded to players, but this is coupled with the fact that Racers now require fewer Upgrade Parts in total to level up. As a result, the pace that you will upgrade Racers has not changed. 

After the conversion to the new system some of your Upgrade Parts will now be required at higher levels than previously. This may mean you cannot use the aforementioned Upgrade Parts immediately, but once you reach these higher levels, you’ll already have some useful materials banked and ready to use. 

[h2]UPGRADE PARTS CONVERSION[/h2]

At the start of Season 4, all existing players will have had their current inventory of old Upgrade Parts converted into the new Upgrade Parts. We tried to design the conversion system in a way that ensured players' Upgrade Parts inventories maintained the same utility.

Some Early Access players may have lost progress due to the streamlined Upgrade Parts system, as a result, we rolled out a gift on October 4 to address this. We attempted to make the conversion as close to 1:1 as possible but this was not achievable in all cases, e.g. License Plates. 

The table below illustrates how old Upgrade Parts were converted into the new system. The key change is the removal of Collection-based Upgrade Parts between Upgrade Levels 1-15, giving players much more flexibility with how they choose to upgrade their Racers early on. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404188/c49a277e722a0393532226d69f9d35266d940499.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404188/a5233f64dca8f254ea2069a320f4f814f7ec5409.png[/img]

The table below illustrates the conversion from the point of view of the Mickey and Friends Collection using Racer Mickey Mouse as an example. The key change is the complete removal of Racer Class-based Collection Upgrade Parts, which also gives players more freedom when upgrading their Racers at the highest levels. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404188/1757b15fe8791dc8405635dfe7914081feb9cc4f.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404188/25273a7c7ed28b0eb8bfec3b239e75ab2963eca6.png[/img]

[h2]UPGRADE PART CATEGORIES[/h2]

[h3]UNIVERSAL UPGRADE PARTS[/h3]

Universal Upgrade Parts can be used to level up any* Racer. 

[*]These Upgrade parts are very common and are required at lower levels. 

*Each Racer Class (Speedster, Defender, Brawler, Tricksters) also has dedicated Universal Upgrade Parts. 

[h3]COLLECTION UPGRADE PARTS
[/h3]

Collection Upgrade Parts can be used to level up Racers from a specific Collection (Mickey & Friends, Monsters, Inc. etc)

[*]These Upgrade parts are less common and are required at intermediate to high levels. 

[h3]RACER UPGRADE PARTS[/h3]

Racer Upgrade Parts can be used to level up specific Racers only. (Mickey Mouse, Woody etc) 


[*]These Upgrade parts are rare and are required to reach the highest Racer levels.

notes.title: Disney Speedstorm Community Pit Stop – Season 4 Update
notes.content:
Hey SpeedStars,

Disney Speedstorm’s fourth Season, “The Cave of Wonders”, is just around the corner, bringing the free-to-play launch of the game! The team has been hard at work making improvements, and we’re here to share them with you!

[h2]UPGRADE MATERIALS IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

The Upgrade Materials system is receiving an overhaul to become more simplified for all players in time for the shift of Disney Speedstorm to free-to-play. The changes include:

•    Reducing the total number of Upgrade Materials per Racer from 15 to 10.
•    Maintaining 3 Universal Materials and 4 Collection Materials (per Collection).
•    Introducing 4 new Class Materials.
•    Changing Material rarity based on the category of the Material.
•    Unifying the types of Materials each Racer needs.

At the start of Season 4, the Upgrade Parts inventory of all existing players will be converted to the new Upgrade Materials. Worry not, the conversion system is designed to ensure that it benefits the player and your new inventory of Upgrade Parts will have at least as much utility as previously, if not more. 

We will explain this new Upgrade Material system in more detail in an upcoming Dev Diary, so please stayed tuned for that. 

[h2]COLLECTION LEVEL IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

The Collection Level system is getting revamped next Season! Following the changes, Collection Level rewards will include Racer Shards, Crew Member Shards, vanity items, Upgrade Parts and in-game currency. 

As part of this change, all players’ Collection Level points will be recalculated at the start of the Season based on their inventory. Players will receive a pop-up informing them of their updated Collection Level, as well as the rewards of all Collection Levels they’ve reached under this new system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404188/ffb37877a5cf3a814425f26bf7bf260a4faf4010.png[/img]

[h2]RACER BALANCING[/h2]

The following changes are being made to Racers’ Unique Skills:

[h3]Stitch[/h3]

•   The size of the projectiles has been decreased by 30%.
•   The duration of the Charged activation has been reduced by 1 second per each Skill level (up to 4 seconds).
•   The lifetime of each projectile has been reduced by 30% during the Charged activation.
•   The speed of the projectiles blasted backwards or sideways during the Charged activation has been slightly reduced.

[h3]Celia Mae[/h3]

•   The amount of Manual Boost fuel gained during both Normal and Charged activations has been increased for each Skill level.
 
[h3]Top Speed/Acceleration[/h3]

The Top Speed and Acceleration stats for the below Racers have been increased at all levels between Racer Level 1 and Racer Level 50. This change gives all of the below Racers a little extra horsepower on the track. 

Mickey Mouse
Hercules
Mowgli
Sulley
Celia Mae
Bo Peep
Jessie
Jumba
Figment

[h2]RANKED MULTIPLAYER CHANGES[/h2]

We’ve noticed that players have signaled issues with racing against CPU Racers, and we are making the following changes to address this:

•   CPU Racers are being disabled in Ranked Multiplayer races for Racers with an MPR over 3. 
•   The number of CPU Racers in Ranked Multiplayer races for Racers with an MPR between 0-3 is being reduced to 4.

[h2]ARBEE DRIVE
[/h2]

Update 3 will introduce an additional control feature to the game – Arbee Drive. With Arbee Drive, the steering and acceleration are controlled by the AI of the game while the player chooses which route to take on the track. All other actions, such as boosting, dashing or using a Skill, remain under the player’s control.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404188/792563aca1586c35c2cdd58e4c97eb09079f7746.png[/img]

You will be able to toggle Arbee Drive on or off before the start of a race, in the mid-race pause menu, or from the controls settings.

[h2]USERNAME CHANGES[/h2]

Starting from this update, all players will have a unique username in the game. On PC and consoles, the default username will be the one of the platform. If your PC or console username is Arbee123, it will default to Arbee123 in-game as well.

If the platform username is already in use by another account, the player ID number will be added to the end of the username. 

Additionally, players will now be able to customize their username from their in-game Player Profile.

[h2]KNOWN ISSUE[/h2]

When dashing a rival Racer, players may occasionally be teleported backwards. This issue will be addressed shortly in an upcoming Hotfix. Stay tuned to our social channels for updates.

[b]These updates will go live alongside Season 3 on August 1.[/b]

[h2]STARTER CIRCUIT [/h2]

We are revamping the Starter Circuit to improve the onboarding experience for new players. The new Starter Circuit has been streamlined while also introducing and explaining new game features to new players more gradually.

[h2]COMMON SKILLS[/h2]

[h3]TELEPORT[/h3]

We collected lots of feedback on challenges the Teleport Skill was causing in Ranked Multiplayer races in particular. We are making the below changes as a first step towards adjusting the skill. 

•	The probability of picking up Teleport is being decreased in general. 
•	The distance from 1st at which Teleport starts to be picked up will be increased. 
•	The distance a Racer is teleported when closer to 1st position will be decreased. 
•	The distance a Racer is teleported when further from 1st position will be increased. 

[h2]GAME MODES[/h2]

•	Racers will be available at different preset Upgrade & Star levels, similar to Local Freeplay. 
•	Crews will not be in effect in this game mode. 

[h3]RANKED & REGULATED MULTIPLAYER[/h3]

•	The correct MPR levels of Racers will now be shown in the Regulated Multiplayer race intro screen.
